tytul: Pasteurized ratatouille: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for French ratatouille, a stew of eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes in olive oil, pasteurized in jars.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
Canning zucchini without pickling is no longer recommended, because research-based processing times are uncertain.
According to NCHFP, fats such as butter or ghee should not be added to the jars, even with liquid, in research-based processes if the original instructions do not call for them.

akapity: Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods are also low-acid, unless their recipes include enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar to make them acid foods.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canning ratatouille from a checked source.
